history.created_by: RUN /bin/sh -c apk upgrade --no-cache &&     apk add --no-cache fuse curl su-exec libgcc libcrypto3 libssl3 &&     addgroup -g 1000 seaweed &&     adduser -D -u 1000 -G seaweed seaweed # buildkit
RUN /bin/sh -c mkdir -p /data/filerldb2 &&     chown -R seaweed:seaweed /data &&     chown -R seaweed:seaweed /etc/seaweedfs &&     chmod 755 /entrypoint.sh # buildkit

RUN /bin/sh -c set -eu;     test "$(cat /tmp/weed-build/evidence/preparation.exit-code)" = 0;     test "$(cat /tmp/weed-build/evidence/package-list.exit-code)" = 0;     test "$(cat /tmp/weed-build/evidence/go-test.exit-code)" = 0;     test "$(cat /tmp/weed-build/evidence/go-test-capture.exit-code)" = 0;     test "$(cat /tmp/weed-build/evidence/build.exit-code)" = 0;     test "$(cat /tmp/weed-build/evidence/build-validation.exit-code)" = 0;     test "$(cat /tmp/weed-build/evidence/go-test-stream.tsv)" = "$(cat /tmp/weed-build/evidence/go-test-concat.tsv)";     cmp /usr/bin/weed /tmp/weed-build/weed;     test "$(stat -c '%u:%g:%a' /usr/bin/weed)" = '0:0:755';     test -s /usr/share/licenses/auto-world-seaweedfs/DERIVATIVE-NOTICE.txt # buildkit
